info.title: Horus Flow Intelligence
info.description:
Live crypto order flow, cross-venue derivatives (Binance, Bybit, OKX) and US market session context, built for AI agents and trading bots. Every directional signal ships with its measured hit rate, and stale data is refused with HTTP 503 instead of being served.

Use your RapidAPI key in Claude, Cursor or any MCP client: add the remote MCP server https://flow.horustek.pro/mcp with the header X-RapidAPI-Key. Your plan applies.

Market scanner: rank about 250 Binance perpetuals in one call (buyers in control, volume surge, breakout candidates).

Plans: BASIC (free) BTCUSDT and ETHUSDT flow, track record, US session. PRO adds every pair, history, climate, breakout scanner, US equity flow, events and cross-asset. ULTRA and MEGA add Cortex, derivatives, composite, market overview, 24h history and webhooks.

Market data, not financial advice.

get.summary: Live order flow for a pair
get.description:
Order book imbalance (top 20 levels) and aggressive trade flow for any TRADING Binance spot pair: 5s and 30s buy/sell delta in USD, depth ratio, large sells in the last 5 minutes (threshold scaled to the pair's 24h volume). Every directional reading carries `reliability`: its measured hit rate at 1/5/15/30 minutes from the live track record. Add `view=compact` for a short answer sized for AI agents. A pair requested for the first time returns 202; retry after 5 seconds.

Plans: BASIC (free) covers BTCUSDT and ETHUSDT; PRO and above cover every Binance spot pair.

get.summary: Futures vs spot, funding and open interest
get.description:
Futures/spot 24h volume vs its 7-day median, mark/index premium, funding, open interest and its 10/30-minute change, positioning signal, and open interest and funding across Binance, Bybit and OKX. Refreshed every 60 seconds.

Plans: ULTRA, MEGA.

example.risk_assessment: MEDIUM — Spot and futures activity are within their normal 7-day range.
example.source: Binance spot + USD-M futures public API; Bybit and OKX public APIs for cross-venue OI and funding
example.method: market_type compares the futures/spot 24h volume ratio with its median over the last 7 complete days (>=1.5x HYPER_SPECULATION, <=0.67x SPOT_DRIVEN). premium_bias uses mark vs index (+/-0.05%). positioning_signal uses 10-minute open-interest change (+1% with price +/-0.2%, or -2% for MASS_DELEVERAGING).

get.description:
Global and top-trader long/short ratios against their own 24h median, smart-money divergence, taker flow, estimated liquidation prices at 100x/50x/25x/10x, and liquidations observed in the last 5 minutes.

Plans: ULTRA, MEGA.

example.source: Binance USD-M futures public API (5m ratios) + forceOrder stream
example.method: crowd_bias compares the global long/short account ratio with its own 24h median (>=1.15x LONG_HEAVY, >=1.35x OVERLEVERAGED_LONG, mirrored for shorts). gravity_score = 0.5*crowd tilt (|ln(ratio vs median)| / ln 1.5) + 0.3*taker imbalance (|buy/sell-1| / 0.5) + 0.2*30-min OI build-up (/3%), each capped at 1. gravity_direction points at the crowded side's liquidation levels (DOWN when the crowd is long) and is NEUTRAL below 0.3 or when the crowd is BALANCED. Liquidation zones are approximate liquidation prices for positions opened at the current price with 100x/50x/25x/10x leverage.

get.description:
Measured hit rates of every directional signal at 1, 5, 15 and 30 minutes, by signal and by confidence bucket, from every signal recorded live since August 2026. Many signals are close to 50%; this endpoint says so.

Plans: all, including BASIC (free).

example.method: Each directional signal (bullish or bearish) is recorded with the Binance price at emission, at most once per symbol and direction every 5 minutes. A hit means the price 1/5/15/30 minutes later moved in the signal's direction; an unchanged price counts as a miss. avg_directional_move_bps is the mean move in the signal's direction in basis points (negative = the market went the other way). Fees are not deducted. A coin flip scores 50%.
example.note: Example trimmed to 3 signals; the live response lists every signal.

get.description:
One call ranks about 250 Binance USDT perpetuals (24h volume >= $5M), each refreshed at least every ~2 minutes from 5-minute candles: 15m and 1h price change, share of notional bought by aggressive buyers, net taker flow in USD, volume surge vs the previous 45 minutes, funding, ignition score, and Horus live flow with its measured hit rate where tracked. Presets answer common questions (where are buyers in control, where is volume surging, breakout candidates with buyers behind them); custom uses the filters. Rankings of current conditions, not predictions.

Plans: BASIC (free) returns the first 3 results; PRO, ULTRA and MEGA return up to 100.

parameters.name: preset
parameters.description: A ready question, or custom to use the filters

parameters.name: min_taker_buy_ratio
parameters.description: custom: minimum aggressive buy share over 15m (0-1)

parameters.name: max_taker_buy_ratio
parameters.description: custom: maximum aggressive buy share over 15m (0-1)

parameters.name: min_volume_surge
parameters.description: custom: minimum volume surge (1 = normal pace)

parameters.name: min_abs_funding
parameters.description: custom: minimum absolute funding rate per 8h (0.0005 = 0.05%)

example.criteria: Aggressive buyers took at least 58% of traded notional over 15 minutes and price is up.

fields.taker_buy_ratio_15m: share of traded notional bought by aggressive buyers over 15 minutes (0.5 = balanced)
fields.net_taker_flow_15m_usd: aggressive buys minus aggressive sells over 15 minutes, USD
fields.volume_surge: average 5-minute volume of the last 15 minutes / the 45 minutes before

example.note: Rankings of current conditions, not predictions. Picks are recorded so their accuracy can be published later.
